Been using your new app for a little bit and I love the cleaner look of it. You seem to have some new stuff on there. Would be nice to get more newer meditations on there on a regular basis.

I was getting ready to start looking for a new app out of boredom of the same ones over and over again. I'm sick of seeing the same ones all the time. 

You STILL definitely need some new ones for sleeping and for morning getting ready to rev up for the day.

Readability of the app is much poorer than it was. 

I do love that it shows all the numbers for your streaks and everything. Nice on the full screen. On the old app, I couldn't for the life of me,  read the whole thing. It always went off the edge of the screen. And no it had nothing to do about zooming in or out or the size of the typeface on my phone. So I love that improvement.

I'm going to attach some photos here of things that make it much harder for me to read. And I know it's not just me.

I don't know why everybody is starting to use white or light typeface on light colored backgrounds. What the hell is that? Even young people should be able to see that it's much harder to see white on a light color. You just can't. Either make the background colors darker or use dark color typeface.

Part of that is you've also  made the print smaller and  thinner so some of us can hardly read it at all. Like the descriptions for instance. I have to put my glasses on to see those. even if I the zoom in I can't read them. I used to be able to before this upgrade.

I love the new typeface you're using on all of it. I just wish you would make it a little bit bigger, because you really shrinked the size of the words. And make it appropriate color for the background. Some pages just need background colors adjusted and made darker for the white print. 

Like I said above, I attached some sample pages marked up with my comments. And these go for all the pages, not just those particular ones.

I hope you give these suggestions some consideration and make some changes.

Thank you. 

Have a beautiful day! 

Kathleen Goggin
